review: Independently read the exact original v4 producer: its failed_metrics and snapshot_ids use push_ids, which writes a u64 big-endian list length; each ID itself retains a u32 byte length.
The candidate adds only Reader::ids_u64 and changes those two Qualification call sites. Request/decision u32 list parsing and all existing fields/signature/domain/authority checks remain unchanged.
ids_u64 checks conversion to usize, <=1024 and the minimum four-byte length-prefix space before allocation/iteration, then calls the existing strict ID parser. There is no fallback to u32.

The regression operates on actual original member bytes and independently locates u64 lists using primitive reads; it checks full decoding and rejects a seven-byte header, altered counts, and a u32-width representation without replacing original seals.
The test transport now announces withdrawal readiness only for the actual original Page(index=0,offset=0); it preserves the original response and pause.
No static type/ownership/blocking issue was identified. This is not a compiler, formatter or test result.
